empty.comment: Inline error under an empty discouraged or preferred term input

selfMapping.source: Must differ from the discouraged term
selfMapping.comment: Inline error when the preferred term equals its own discouraged term (case-insensitive)
selfMapping.es: Must differ from the discouraged term
selfMapping.fr-ca: Must differ from the discouraged term
selfMapping.ru: Must differ from the discouraged term
selfMapping.ja: Must differ from the discouraged term
selfMapping.de: Must differ from the discouraged term

duplicateX.comment: Inline error when the discouraged term {{ term }} appears in an earlier rule

chainX.comment: Inline error when the preferred term {{ term }} is another rule's discouraged term, whose preferred term is {{ preferred }}

containsDiscouragedX.comment: Inline error when the preferred term contains the discouraged term {{ term }} as a whole word

cycleX.source: Leads back to “{term}” in a cycle
cycleX.comment: Inline error when following preferred terms from this rule returns to its discouraged term {{ term }}
cycleX.es: Leads back to “{term}” in a cycle
cycleX.fr-ca: Leads back to “{term}” in a cycle
cycleX.ru: Leads back to “{term}” in a cycle
cycleX.ja: Leads back to “{term}” in a cycle
cycleX.de: Leads back to “{term}” in a cycle

invalidType.comment: Inline error when a rule field is not a string (only reachable through server validation)

invalidCharacter.comment: Inline error when a term contains ICU or HTML syntax characters
